pathway: General land-surface structure; compact summary of terrain/vegetation/settlement semantics
notes: 64-dim embedding field. Fixed 2017 vintage for all countries; treat as time-invariant descriptor.

pathway: Greenness -> crop/forage productivity -> dietary diversity
notes: Scale factor 1e-4 applied at harmonisation; raw exports are DN.

pathway: Growing-season anomaly -> acute food availability shock
notes: Missing for Tanzania; excluded from the all-country intersection.

pathway: Greenness (atmospherically robust) -> crop productivity
notes: Already scaled in every export; no conversion needed.

pathway: Canopy density -> biomass and forage
notes: Scale 0.1. Raster path exported raw DN; EE path pre-scaled. Reconciled at harmonisation.

pathway: Net primary productivity -> agricultural output
notes: Scale 1e-4. Raster path raw DN; EE path pre-scaled. Reconciled at harmonisation. QC band dropped.

pathway: Dekadal NPP -> irrigated/rainfed cropping intensity
notes: Annual mean/sd of dekadal slices; bands are a time series so summaries are meaningful.

pathway: Rainfall -> crop yield and seasonal food availability
notes: Monthly product averaged to annual mean.

pathway: Water balance / temperature -> agro-ecology and crop suitability
notes: 14 distinct bands; per-band scale factors applied. Cross-band summaries are meaningless and are dropped.

pathway: Night-time land-surface temperature -> agro-ecology and vector ecology
notes: PRODUCT MISMATCH: four countries from Oxford MAP (degC); Tanzania from a MODIS-derived source in Kelvin. Converted then flagged for validation.

pathway: Land-surface water/energy balance
notes: Exported only as a mean/sd COLLAPSE over 28 incommensurable bands (dominated by surface pressure). Not a physical quantity. Re-extract per band to reinstate.

pathway: Cloud/water vapour
notes: Collapsed over incommensurable optical bands; also missing for Tanzania.

pathway: Aerosol optical depth -> air quality and biomass burning
notes: Single valid band but absent for Tanzania; re-extract to reinstate.

pathway: Density -> urbanicity market access and diet
notes: UN-adjusted; 5-yr epochs interpolated to annual in the export.

pathway: Population count -> settlement scale
notes: EPOCH MISMATCH: Gambia 2020 vs 2015 elsewhere.

pathway: Built surface -> urbanicity and infrastructure
notes: EPOCH MISMATCH: Gambia 2020 vs 2015 elsewhere. Residential/non-residential split retained.

pathway: Degree of urbanisation
notes: Zonal MEAN of an ordinal settlement class code is not a physical quantity. Reinstate as class fractions.

pathway: Settlement footprint -> urbanicity
notes: 2015 single epoch for all countries.

pathway: Night-time lights -> economic activity and electrification
notes: 2013 for all countries. Highly skewed; consider log1p downstream.

pathway: Cumulative human modification of terrestrial systems
notes: 2016 single epoch for all countries.

pathway: Travel time to healthcare -> service utilisation and supplementation
notes: EPOCH MISMATCH: Tanzania 2015 vs 2019 elsewhere.

pathway: Elevation -> agro-ecological zone and malaria transmission
notes: SRTM 30 m; genuinely large between-country differences are real geography not a unit defect.

pathway: Cover composition -> cropping systems and diet
notes: Only the *_coverfraction bands are retained; classification codes and QC bands dropped.

pathway: Land-cover class
notes: Zonal MEAN of categorical class codes is meaningless. Reinstate as per-class area fractions.

pathway: Active cropland by crop type -> staple availability
notes: Band is masked outside cropland so a zonal mean returns the class code not a cropland fraction; tile ids are country-specific. Reinstate via an unmasked fraction computation.

pathway: Grassland extent -> livestock and animal-source foods
notes: Absent for Tanzania in the current build.

pathway: Age-sex structure
notes: Exported only as a mean/sd collapse over 77 age-sex count bins; not a rate and not commensurable.

pathway: Soil nutrient status -> crop nutrient density -> human micronutrient intake
notes: Eleven properties. Depth means retained; cross-band _annual_* summaries dropped because they average location and dispersion together.

pathway: Soil texture and fertility -> crop nutrient density -> human micronutrient intake
notes: 0-5 cm depth means. Distinct from the iSDAsoil gee_soil* block; both are retained because they disagree in places and neither is a gold standard.

pathway: Crop mix -> staple composition of the local diet
notes: Production is an ABSOLUTE count so it scales with district size; prefer the spam_share_* variables for cross-country comparison.

pathway: Service coverage and household conditions -> nutrition and infection burden
notes: Survey-year prefixes are stripped by rule 60 so the same indicator matches across countries. CAUTION: these are survey-derived - check the shared-survey leakage criterion before using one whose survey round overlaps the biomarker outcome.

pathway: Helminth and schistosome infection -> gut loss and anaemia
notes: Portal download is manual; no file is present in the current build so no ESPEN column ships.
